item.title: Rallying Cry – October 11, 2026
item.description: In exciting news, orangutans have been released back into the Borneo forest after devastating fires, while seniors in Singapore are rewriting the narrative on retirement, and Denmark is testing humanoid robots in supermarkets to lighten the workload for staff.
